supplemental_items.interpretation: Create fresh default Primary aggregate. Choose run crossing if run is non-null, otherwise native strict crossing. Allocate empty seen-pair set. Enumerate qualifying seeds in generator order. Update earliest qualification before dedup; null short-circuits strict earlier comparison. Normalize both reference and second indexes for identity; omit times. Skip already seen pair even if first seed had no crossing. Mark pair seen before price read/crossing. Read reference main High at integer index and normalize Decimal. Request strictly later upward crossing after qualification. Only non-null hit creates activation. Append hit, reference, second and qualification preserving identity.

Stable sort by hit time, qualification, raw reference index and raw second index. Only non-null run receives schedule. Materialize sorted activation identities, including empty schedule. Empty activation returns without retained-step replay. Qualified but no crossing sets waiting-for-stopall-break; otherwise keep default.

findings.description: Qualification minimum includes duplicates and seeds without crossing because it precedes dedup. Mark pair seen before crossing so a later duplicate cannot retry a missing hit. Schedule publication precedes empty-activation return, including an empty schedule; no retained steps are replayed on that return.
